usageNote: 口语短语！考试、比赛、评分都能用，表示拿到最高分，超有成就感的说法！

examples.en: She practiced every day and finally got a perfect score of 10 in the gymnastics competition.
examples.zh: 她每天练习，终于在体操比赛中拿到了满分10分。

examples.en: It's really hard to get a perfect score of 10 on this professor's exam.
examples.zh: 在这位教授的考试中拿满分真的很难。
